connector.name: xProof
connector.registryDescription: Proof primitive for AI agents on MultiversX. Anchor file hashes on-chain as verifiable proofs.
connector.summary: Hosted at xproof.app over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the jasonxkensei account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer API key (format: Bearer pm_xxx). Optional — x402 payment works without authentication.
